name: klinikatop
description: KlinikaTop — tibbiy taklif platformasi (Telegram Mini App)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=webapp
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=webapp && npm run build:site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=webapp
scripts.build:site: npm ci --prefix site --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix site && node deploy/merge-site.mjs

_engines_note: Node 18 — serverda ham aynan shu. better-sqlite3 mahalliy modul: u qaysi Node uchun qurilgan bo'lsa, faqat o'shanda ishlaydi. Boshqa versiyada testlar 'segmentation fault' bilan yiqiladi va sabab ko'rinmaydi.
